subject: Re: Kickoff: dual-pixel depth for the imaging pipeline
body:
Lucia,

Staffing: Fumiko leads modeling and owns the affine-invariance question, Kaia the dataset pipeline and reproduction, Linnea the mobile-sizing work, Saoirse the on-device runtime path.

Compute: reproduction and ablations fit titan-a100 best-effort — DPNet-scale training is 16 GPUs for ~3 days per run.

The key scoped build: the mobile milestone needs the big DPNet compressed into something that fits the imaging pipeline's latency budget, so we are scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe built from scratch — Linnea leads it at 70% starting April 20. Teacher-student setup against DPNet, affine-invariant distillation losses, quantization-aware fine-tuning at the end. Nothing exists in-house to reuse for this, so I've budgeted seven engineer-weeks with the recipe producing its first mobile-sized student by May 22.

Dataset note: the released set is slightly smaller than the paper's, so expect reproduced metrics to match the updated reference numbers, not the original table.

Bruno
